response.original_title: Tom Robbins: A Writer in the Rain
response.overview: A half-hour program about the life and writing of this popular author. Partially funded by Bumbershoot, The Seattle Arts Festival. Broadcast on KCTS, and screened at Bumbershoot award ceremony honoring Robbins, August 1997. Distributed nationally by PBS Adult Learning Services.
response.title: Tom Robbins: A Writer in the Rain
